fields.content: We collect your name, contact info, and preferences when you create a Lido Shores Resort account. During your stay, we use this info to customize your experience, from room setup to personalized recommendations. Data like dining and room service requests may be combined for seamless service. You can manage your preferences anytime or contact us for support. Please follow resort policies for a pleasant stay. Review our Guest Terms and Privacy Policy for details.
